split.note: StratifiedGroupKFold(shuffle=True, random_state=seed); fold 0 = model_val, fold 1 = routing_val, folds 2-9 = fit

selection_metric: macro-F1 over the fixed 77 label IDs on model_val

embedding.revision_note: Pinned after the first run (hub commit resolved on 2026-11-07).

within_family_selection: tie (equal after rounding to 4 decimals): fewer TF-IDF features, then smaller C, then grid order
edge rule: if the winner's C is at the edge of C_grid, fit the same representation once at the edge_extension value; adopt it only if its rounded macro-F1 is strictly higher
deployment_selection: highest model_val macro-F1 rounded to 4 decimals among C1-C4
then lower median warm batch-one latency on the same machine
then C1, C2, C3, C4 order
